lines.text: The psalmist loves the LORD for hearing his plea, and when death's ropes entangled him, he called on Him.
The LORD delivered his soul from death, his eyes from tears, and his feet from stumbling.
In his alarm he said, "All men are liars!"
He will lift the cup of blessing and fulfill his vows before all His people.
He will offer a thanksgiving sacrifice and keep his vows in the LORD's courts, in the midst of Samaria.
